cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: We Needed the Break
cards.instruction: Frame a rupture, absence, or failed connection as a healthy decision that ultimately helped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Just us for lunch. That disastrous family reunion did us a favour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We shouted over each other until everyone left.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Exactly. We learned an audience makes us compete.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter just asked if we're expecting twelve more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him two. We're already applying what we learned; nobody has to storm out to get a turn.

mechanism: A describes a failed family reunion as a successful lesson it gave B in speaking without competing for an audience.
confusable: Not mutual discovery alone: A grades B and makes the smaller lunch an application of its claimed teaching.
comparison: Independent calendar versus shared speaking space.
